newsitem.title: THAILAND: Italian Thai to sign two billion baht phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Italian Thai to sign two billion baht phone deal.

text.p: Construction firm Italian Thai Development Plc has won a two-billion baht ($50 million) contract to install 800,000 provincial telephone lines in Thailand, senior executives said on Thursday.

A contract with the state Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT) will be signed Friday and work is expected to begin in the third quarter this year, Italian Thai Vice-President Chatichai Chutima told Reuters.
"We put in the lowest bid for the project. After signing we will wait for notification to proceed from the TOT. We then expect the project to be completed within two years," he said.
